```{r}
# =============================================================================
#  State module summary  +  pull ALL parent-term genes, flag State DEGs,
#  per-State pseudobulk heatmap
#  Downstream of: parent_terms_df (representative modules per State)
# =============================================================================
#
#  Part 1  Per-State module summary, ranked by REAL marker stats (not `score`).
#  Part 2  Pull ALL genes of each parent term from genesets_mouse_final,
#          then MARK which genes are also State DEGs (no filtering).
#  Part 3  Per-State average expression z-score heatmap of the pulled genes,
#          with a DEG row annotation.
#
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  >>> CHECK THIS CONFIG BLOCK AGAINST YOUR ENVIRONMENT BEFORE RUNNING <<<
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

seu          <- MG.recluster.obj          # your Seurat object
state_col    <- "state_anno"                   # metadata column holding State1..State5
rna_assay    <- "RNA"                      # gene-expression assay ("RNA" or "SCT")
states       <- c("State1","State2","State3","State4","State5")
# genesets_mouse_final : named list  gene_set_name -> character vector of genes
# state_colors         : named vector State -> colour
# state.each.pathway.markers.sig.fld : pathway-level marker table

# parent_terms_df <- read.csv("MAY_parent_terms_df_MG.csv", row.names = 1,
#                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 0.25
min_pct  <- 0.10


# =============================================================================
#  PART 1 — State module summary  (ranked by real stats, not `score`)
# =============================================================================
pathway_stats <- state.each.pathway.markers.sig.fld %>%
  dplyr::transmute(cluster,
                   term       = gene,        # pathway name lives in `gene`
                   avg_log2FC,                # <- rename if your table differs
                   p_val_adj)                 # <- rename if your table differs

state_summary <- parent_terms_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pathway_stats, by = c("term", "cluster")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_states = dplyr::n_distinct(cluster),
                is_shared = n_states > 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC))

state_overview <- state_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_modules        = dplyr::n(),
                   n_state_specific = sum(!is_shared),
                   n_shared         = sum(is_shared),
                   top5_modules     = paste(head(term[order(-avg_log2FC)], 5),
                                            collapse = " | "),
                   .groups = "drop")

print(state_overview)
write.csv(state_summary,  "state_module_summary_full.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(state_overview, "state_module_overview.csv",     row.names = FALSE)


# =============================================================================
#  PART 2 — Pull ALL parent-term genes, then flag State DEGs
# =============================================================================
# (A) Gene-level State DEGs on the RNA assay.
#     If you already have a gene-level marker table, assign it to `gene_markers`
#     and skip FindAllMarkers (it can be slow).
DefaultAssay(seu) <- rna_assay
Idents(seu)       <- state_col
gene_markers <- Seurat::FindAllMarkers(seu, only.pos = TRUE,
                                       min.pct = min_pct,
                                       logfc.threshold = lfc_cut)

deg_pairs <- gene_markers %>%                       # (gene, state) DEG pairs
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < padj_cut) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, cluster)

deg_state_map <- deg_pairs %>%                      # gene -> which state(s) DEG
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(deg_states = paste(sort(unique(cluster)), collapse = ","),
                   n_deg_states = dplyr::n_distinct(cluster), .groups = "drop")

# (B) Pull EVERY gene of each parent term (no filtering), keep module+State link
missing_terms <- setdiff(parent_terms_df$term, names(genesets_mouse_final))
if (length(missing_terms) > 0)
  warning(sprintf("%d module(s) not in genesets_mouse_final: %s",
                  length(missing_terms), paste(head(missing_terms, 5), collapse = ", ")))

module_gene_long <- parent_terms_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(term, cluster) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = list(genesets_mouse_final[[term]])) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::unnest(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), nzchar(gene)) %>%
  # flag: DEG in the SAME state as its module  (== the "leading-edge" subset)
  dplyr::mutate(is_deg_in_state =
                  paste(gene, cluster) %in% paste(deg_pairs$gene, deg_pairs$cluster)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(deg_state_map, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(is_deg_any = !is.na(deg_states))

message(sprintf("Pulled %d unique genes from %d modules; %d are DEG in some state, %d are DEG in their own module's state.",
                dplyr::n_distinct(module_gene_long$gene),
                dplyr::n_distinct(module_gene_long$term),
                dplyr::n_distinct(module_gene_long$gene[module_gene_long$is_deg_any]),
                dplyr::n_distinct(module_gene_long$gene[module_gene_long$is_deg_in_state])))

write.csv(module_gene_long, "parent_term_genes_with_DEG_flag.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# (C) one row per gene for the heatmap (genes can come from several modules)
gene_tab <- module_gene_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(from_states  = paste(sort(unique(cluster)), collapse = ","),
                   n_src_states = dplyr::n_distinct(cluster),
                   n_modules    = dplyr::n_distinct(term),
                   is_deg_any   = any(is_deg_any),
                   deg_states   = dplyr::first(deg_states),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  # source State of the gene's parent term(s): single State, else "Multiple"
  dplyr::mutate(source_state = ifelse(n_src_states == 1, from_states, "Multiple"),
                source_state = factor(source_state, levels = c(states, "Multiple")))


# =============================================================================
#  PART 3 — Per-State average expression z-score heatmap (DEG-annotated)
# =============================================================================
feat <- intersect(gene_tab$gene, rownames(seu[[rna_assay]]))
gene_tab <- dplyr::filter(gene_tab, gene %in% feat)

avg <- Seurat::AverageExpression(seu, assays = rna_assay,
                                 features = gene_tab$gene,
                                 group.by = state_col,
                                 layer = "data")[[rna_assay]]   # v4: slot="data"
avg <- avg[gene_tab$gene, states, drop = FALSE]
mat <- as.matrix(avg)

# --- Drop zero-variance (flat) genes: they z-score to NaN / all-zero rows ---
#     IMPORTANT: filter mat AND gene_tab together so the row annotation stays aligned.
keep <- apply(mat, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 & is.finite(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
message(sprintf("Dropping %d zero-variance gene(s); %d retained.", sum(!keep), sum(keep)))
mat      <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
gene_tab <- gene_tab[keep, , drop = FALSE]
gene_tab$source_state <- droplevels(gene_tab$source_state)   # avoid empty slices

# z-score per gene across States (no NA left now, but guard just in case)
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat_z[is.na(mat_z)] <- 0

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

# colours for the source-State annotation (your palette + grey for multi-source)
src_cols <- c(state_colors[states], Multiple = "grey60")

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  SourceState = gene_tab$source_state,                 # State of the parent term
  DEG         = ifelse(gene_tab$is_deg_any, "DEG", "not DEG"),
  col = list(SourceState = src_cols,
             DEG = c("DEG" = "#D7301F", "not DEG" = "grey85")),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE
)

h_genes <- Heatmap(
  mat_z,
  name               = "z-score",
  col                = col_fun,
  cluster_columns    = FALSE,
  cluster_rows       = TRUE,                  # cluster WITHIN each State block
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,                 # keep block order State1..State5, Multiple
  row_split          = gene_tab$source_state, # block rows by source-term State
  show_row_dend      = FALSE,
  left_annotation    = row_anno,
  show_row_names     = nrow(mat_z) <= 80,
  row_names_gp       = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6),
  row_title_gp       = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  show_column_names  = TRUE,
  column_title       = sprintf("Parent-term genes (%d) | per-State z-score | DEGs flagged",
                               nrow(mat_z)),
  use_raster         = TRUE
)

pdf("./Figure_Final/parent_term_genes_DEGflag_htmp.pdf", width = 8, height = 11)
draw(h_genes)
dev.off()

h_genes
```
